title: Add a new patient from Referral Intake

claims.claim: Inbound faxes are handled in the Fax Review Queue instead, where the action is Approve & Create Patient.
First name, last name, and date of birth are the only required fields.

checks.pattern: dateOfBirth: z.string().min(1, "Date of Birth is required"),
"Subscriber Date of Birth is required for insurance plans where the subscriber is not the patient. Please complete the Insurance section.",
checks.note: no other field may block save

claims.finding: Name and DOB are the only always-required fields, but once an insurance row is added, Create Patient is blocked when a non-self subscriber has no Subscriber Date of Birth (ReferralsNewPage.tsx:2905-2913), and when the subscriber name does not match the patient until Subscriber Relationship is set (:2894-2902).
claims.proposed_text: You know the patient's first name, last name, and date of birth. Those three fields are always required. If you add insurance where the subscriber is not the patient, Subscriber Date of Birth is required too.

proposed_checks.pattern: dateOfBirth: z.string().min(1, "Date of Birth is required"),
"Subscriber Date of Birth is required for insurance plans where the subscriber is not the patient. Please complete the Insurance section.",

claims.reason: Insurance rows add more required input (Subscriber Date of Birth for a non-self subscriber; Subscriber Relationship when the name does not match). Replaced by ri-nr-27.

claims.claim: You can save the patient without the referring practice and insurance information and add them later.

checks.pattern: You can create the patient without insurance, or add

checks.note: submit validation covers demographics only; practice fields are optional

claims.claim: Click Referral Intake in the sidebar. The board heading is Patient Intake.
You can also press ⌘K (Windows: Ctrl+K) and type "new referral" — the command item is titled New Referrals and opens the form.
claims.finding: ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens the command bar (AppShell.tsx:1141), but its items come from AppShell.tsx:807-850: the sidebar labels plus a short list (Fax review queue, Clinical inventory view, CRM Home, ...). There is no New Referrals item, so typing "new referral" finds nothing. The "New Referrals" item lives in frontend/src/utils/navigationUtils.ts:46, used only by components/app-shell/AppShell.tsx, which nothing imports.
claims.proposed_text: You can also press ⌘K (Windows: Ctrl+K), type "referral", and choose Referral Intake to open the board.
claims.reason: The ⌘K command bar has no New Referrals item. Replaced by ri-nr-28.

claims.claim: Click Add New Referral in the top-right (alongside Fax Queue and Fleet Calendar).
The form heading is Add New Patient. Click Create Patient at the bottom; if you are offline, the same button reads Save Offline.
The form restates at the bottom: "Required fields: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth."

checks.pattern: * Required fields: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth

claims.claim: Care Type: Wound Care or Primary Care. Helper text: "Select the type of care this patient is being referred for."

checks.pattern: Select the type of care this patient is being referred for

claims.claim: Patient Demographics: First Name, Middle Initial, Last Name, Date of Birth, Sex (Male, Female, Other), Marital Status, Employment Status, Primary Phone Number, Secondary Phone Number, Email Address.

checks.pattern: ^ +(First Name|Middle Initial|Last Name|Date of Birth|Marital Status|Employment Status|Primary Phone Number|Secondary Phone Number|Email Address)$

claims.claim: Address Information: Street Address, Lives at, City, State, ZIP Code. Phone and address are optional.

checks.pattern: // PR-21 (2026-05-17): downgraded phone + address from required to optional

claims.claim: Referring Information Practice & Physician: Referral Source (search CRM practices), Add New Practice, Referring Individual, Date Referral Sent, Referral Entry Date, Referral ID, practice phone and fax, Referring Physician and Referring Physician NPI, Assigned BD Rep.

checks.pattern: ^ +(Referral Source|Referring Individual|Date Referral Sent|Referral Entry Date|Referral ID|Referring Phone|Practice Fax|Referring Physician|Referring Physician NPI|Assigned BD Rep)$

claims.claim: Patient's Primary Care Physician: PCP Practice, PCP Physician, phone, fax, and PCP Physician NPI.

checks.pattern: ^ +(PCP Practice|PCP Physician|PCP Practice Phone|PCP Practice Fax|PCP Physician NPI)$

claims.claim: Insurance Information: click Add Insurance for each payer. Fields: Insurance Provider, Policy Number / Member Number, Group Number (optional), Subscriber First Name, Subscriber Last Name, Payer ID, Subscriber Relationship (Self, Spouse, Child, Other). Use Verify (or Verify again) to run eligibility. You can add more than one insurance row.

checks.pattern: ^ +(Policy Number / Member Number|Subscriber First Name|Subscriber Last Name|Payer ID|Subscriber Relationship)$

claims.claim: Urgency: Referral Reason, and Urgency Level: Routine, Urgent, or Emergent.

Condition & Accident Information For Billing: optional checkboxes Related to Employment, Related to Auto Accident, Related to Other Accident, plus Auto Accident State when that box is checked. Under Billing Preferences: Accept Assignment of Benefits.

checks.pattern: ^ +(Related to Employment|Related to Auto Accident|Related to Other Accident|Auto Accident State|Billing Preferences|Accept Assignment of Benefits)$

claims.claim: Insurance Verification Summary: a recap of the insurance rows you added, if any.

checks.pattern: Review verification results for all insurance plans

claims.claim: At the bottom you can also check Send digital consent form via SMS upon approval, or click Send Consent SMS if a primary phone number is entered.

checks.pattern: Send digital consent form via SMS upon approval

claims.claim: Cancel leaves the form without saving.

checks.note: Cancel only navigates away (to All Patients)

claims.claim: Clicking Create Patient creates the patient record immediately (status Active) and a referral in the New Referrals column.
A success message reads "Referral created successfully!" and includes the MRN when one is assigned.
After a short pause you are taken back to the Patient Intake board. The detail panel does not open by itself.
The card does not move to Financial automatically when insurance is present, and the patient does not wait for an Assigned status before appearing in All Patients.
You cannot create the patient when First Name, Last Name, or Date of Birth is empty; the form lists any that are still missing.

checks.pattern: Please complete the following required fields:

claims.claim: "Please enter a valid phone number" means a phone was entered in a format the form does not accept. Use (xxx) xxx-xxxx, or leave the field blank.

checks.pattern: message: "Please enter a valid phone number",

claims.claim: When the button reads Save Offline you can save the referral offline and finish it when you reconnect.

checks.pattern: description: "Will sync when connection is restored",

claims.claim: First Name, Last Name, and Date of Birth are always required. If you add insurance where the subscriber is not the patient, Subscriber Date of Birth is required too, and a subscriber name that does not match the patient needs a Subscriber Relationship.

checks.pattern: dateOfBirth: z.string().min(1, "Date of Birth is required"),
"Subscriber Date of Birth is required for insurance plans where the subscriber is not the patient. Please complete the Insurance section.",
"The subscriber name on this insurance does not match the patient. Either correct the spelling, or set the Subscriber Relationship — choose Self if this IS the patient.",

claims.claim: You can also press ⌘K (Windows: Ctrl+K), type "referral", and choose Referral Intake to open the board.

Troubleshooting: "Subscriber Date of Birth is required…" — an insurance row has a subscriber who is not the patient and no subscriber date of birth. Enter Subscriber Date of Birth, or set Subscriber Relationship to Self if the subscriber is the patient.
